name: Pulse Panel
description: Exec-mode Pulse tab: KPI pollers + metric graphs (sparklines) served over pulsepanel.* RPCs. Split from tinkerclaw-control-panel 2026-07-24. RECURRING NETWORK ACTIVITY: while the gateway runs, a background timer ticks every `polling.tickSeconds` (default 60s) and re-fetches every configured metric whose own cadence is due. It ships with NO metrics configured, so a fresh install makes no third-party request until you add one via `seedMetrics` or the pulsepanel.add-metric RPC; the hosts contacted then follow from the sources you choose (api.github.com, api.npmjs.org, oauth2.googleapis.com and analyticsdata.googleapis.com for GA4, www.googleapis.com, www.moltbook.com). Set `polling.enabled: false` to serve the RPCs with the timer stopped. CREDENTIALS: every credential is supplied by you under `credentials` in plugin config; the plugin reads no environment variables and no credential store on its own initiative, runs no external programs, and a poller with nothing configured is skipped. LOCAL FILES: the `localstate` source reads a numeric value from a `.json` file inside ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/online-presence/ only; absolute paths, `..` segments and symlinks that resolve outside that directory are rejected. STORAGE: it creates and writes only its own metric tables (metric_definition, observation, alert_state, panel_pin) in the shared SQLite store; the task/briefing/calendar tables belong to tinkerclaw-task-panel and are left untouched unless you set `manageTaskSchema`. RPCs: pulsepanel.{ping,list,add-metric,record,query,metrics.poll} plus their legacy control-panel.* aliases.

dataDir.description: Directory holding the shared control-panel SQLite store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/data/control-panel/

manageTaskSchema.description: Let this plugin create and migrate the task/briefing/calendar tables in the shared store. Those tables are owned by tinkerclaw-task-panel, which bootstraps them itself — enabling this makes the Pulse panel rewrite the task table and seed taxonomy rows. Only turn it on when running Pulse WITHOUT the task panel.

polling.description: Recurring background polling of the configured metric sources.

enabled.description: Run the background poll timer. False keeps every RPC working (including on-demand pulsepanel.metrics.poll) but makes no scheduled outbound request.

tickSeconds.description: Seconds between poll ticks. Each tick only fetches metrics whose own cadence_seconds is due.

credentials.description: Credentials you supply for the optional pollers. Nothing here has a default path: a poller with no credential configured is skipped rather than reading another application's credential store.

githubToken.description: OPTIONAL GitHub token. The github.stargazers/forks/open_issues pollers call public endpoints anonymously without it (60 req/h per IP); a token raises that to 5000/h. REQUIRED for github.traffic.daily, whose views/clones endpoints need push access on the repository. Also REQUIRED for github.activity (GraphQL).

moltbookApiKeyFile.description: Path to a JSON file containing {"api_key": "..."} used by the moltbook.* pollers.

youtubeApiKeyFile.description: Path to a file containing a YouTube Data API v3 key, used by youtube.channelStats.

ga4ServiceAccountFile.description: Path to a Google service-account JSON key granted Viewer on the GA4 property, used by ga4.sessions.

seedMetrics.description: Metrics to create on boot if they do not already exist. Empty by default — the plugin polls nothing until you list something here or call pulsepanel.add-metric.

source.description: "<pollerKey>:<args>". Keys: github.stargazers, github.forks, github.open_issues, github.traffic.daily, github.activity, npm.downloads.weekly, npm.downloads.monthly, ga4.sessions, moltbook.{karma,posts,comments,followers}, youtube.channelStats, localstate ("<file>.json#dot.path", file confined to ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/online-presence/), demo.website.visits. Example: github.activity:commits:owner/repo

cadenceSeconds.description: How often this metric is re-fetched.

template.description: sparkline → Graphs section; single-stat → KPIs section.

dataDir.label: Data dir
dataDir.help: Where the shared SQLite store lives.

manageTaskSchema.label: Manage task tables
manageTaskSchema.help: Off by default. Only for running Pulse without tinkerclaw-task-panel.

polling.label: Polling
polling.help: Recurring background fetches of your configured metrics.

credentials.label: Credentials
credentials.help: Optional, per-poller. Unset means that poller is skipped.

seedMetrics.label: Metrics
seedMetrics.help: Which sources to graph. Empty means nothing is polled.
